The Army Corps of Engineers will conduct final lease negotiations and oversee the projects, including conducting environmental reviews, according to the Army. The agreements come after a 2025 executive order from President Donald Trump that sought to make available underutilized federal land for commercial data center projects. Carlyle was selected to build on about 1,384 acres at Fort Bliss, according to the Army. That

CyrusOne, a company held by investment giants KKR and BlackRock, was selected to build on about approximately 1,201 acres on Dugway Proving Ground. That project is expected to be completed around 2029.
